title: Align Result Validator Contract
description: Aligns dependency-free gateway result validation with the normative JSON schema and adds regression coverage.

requirements.summary: Enforce schema scalar types and byte bounds in the dependency-free validator.
acceptance: Commit identifiers must be strings rather than values coercible to strings.
Boolean gate exits and oversized gate summaries are rejected.
next_action is validated whenever present and remains bounded.

requirements.summary: Validate deviation values and preserve the portable validator copy.
acceptance: Deviation string and requirements item types match the schema.
The canonical and gateway-compatible validator copies are byte-identical.
Native tests cover the corrected mismatch cases.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Reconstructed the committed validator and test files by exact Git blob identity.
Authored and locally executed the new focused regression cases.
Verified the two validator copies are byte-identical and the patch passes git diff --check.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: The complete planner test suite and committed evidence workflow require the host repository.
forbidden_deviations: Do not modify files outside the three declared paths.
Do not redesign the result schema or gateway protocol.
Do not merge, release, tag, amend, rebase, or force-push.
